mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the wider vessels in warmth with narrower vessels in cold was most worthwhile: the pictures linked blood flow near the skin to heat loss.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sensing the two temperatures felt somewhat repetitive, though it showed that the brain receives signals in both situations.

surprise.text: It was useful to see sweat signals fade as the temperature moved back toward its earlier range, rather than sweating simply continuing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although most of the cold pathway offered only one gameplay action at a time, so there was little choice in how to follow it.

continue.text: I would probably continue: comparing the two responses helped me understand how the same body handles different conditions, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
